metadata.name: private_loan_v2
metadata.description: ZenLo V2 private loans on MagicBlock: multi-loan rooms, V2 accounting, governed authorities

instructions.name: accept_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Borrower accepts `revision`: one accepted proposal per borrowing request.

accounts.name: anchor
docs: Writable: on first acceptance it pays rent for the room deal record.

instructions.name: add_collateral
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Borrower adds wSOL; no price needed.

accounts.name: anchor
docs: Writable: on first acceptance it pays rent for the room deal record.

instructions.name: add_loan_reader
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender and borrower together add a reader to a loan.

accounts.name: lender
docs: The lender for `add_loan_reader`; the lender or borrower for `remove_loan_reader`.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Required with the lender to add a reader.

instructions.name: ai_callback
docs: Ephemeral rollup. The worker stores the claimed typed answer once.

instructions.name: attach_desk
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A desk lender places a draft under the current policy and the desk book.

instructions.name: cancel_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender cancels before acceptance; principal returns.

instructions.name: claim_ai_request
docs: Ephemeral rollup. The worker claims the single paid generation attempt.

instructions.name: claim_priced_recovery
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender, from 24 hours after grace: payoff-equivalent wSOL, surplus returned.

instructions.name: claim_terminal
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender, from seven days after grace: all remaining wSOL, no price.

instructions.name: create_ai_request
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A member binds an approved excerpt hash (and loan revision) to a request.

instructions.name: create_loan
docs: Base layer. The lender creates a loan anchor (creator + nonce) and its delegated eATAs.

accounts.name: receipt
docs: Created empty now, so the settlement action later writes it without paying rent.

accounts.name: usdc_ata
docs: Base token accounts the ER mirrors for this loan's custody. Without them
the custody ATAs do not exist inside the rollup.

instructions.name: create_session
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A member authorises a session key for nonfinancial actions.

instructions.name: delegate_desk
docs: Base layer. Delegates the desk anchor (same transaction as `open_desk`).

instructions.name: delegate_loan
docs: Base layer. Delegates the loan anchor (same transaction as `create_loan`).

instructions.name: delegate_room
docs: Base layer. Delegates the room anchor to the TEE (same transaction as `open_room`).

instructions.name: edit_terms
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender edits terms before funding; the revision moves.

instructions.name: fund_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Lender locks the principal for `revision`.

instructions.name: fund_quote
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A liquidator funds the current quote revision.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Base layer, once. The program's upgrade authority writes the separated authorities.

instructions.name: init_desk
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Creates the private member list; the creator is the first administrator.

instructions.name: init_liquidation_pool
docs: Base layer. The liquidation-pool admin from `Config` creates the pool.

instructions.name: init_room
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Creates the private member list and thread. The owner names their own roles.

instructions.name: invite_member
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Owner adds a member with role bits and widens both permissions.

instructions.name: open_desk
docs: Base layer. Opens a lender desk namespaced by its creator.

instructions.name: open_join_queue
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Owner creates the join queue only they can read.

instructions.name: open_room
docs: Base layer. Creates the room anchor, namespaced by its creator, and funds it.

instructions.name: post_message
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A member, or a session with post scope, posts a message.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The member's wallet, or a session key with `SCOPE_POST_MESSAGE`.

instructions.name: propose_terms
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Initial private setup: roles, room binding, the next room index.

instructions.name: publish_card
docs: Base layer. Room owner publishes an opt-in public card with chosen fields.

accounts.name: room
docs: The room anchor on Solana. Delegated, so read through its stored creator only.

instructions.name: publish_policy
docs: Ephemeral rollup. An administrator publishes the next immutable policy version.

instructions.name: publish_receipt
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Commits the loan anchor with an action that writes the settlement receipt.

instructions.name: record_receipt
docs: Base layer, Magic Action only: writes the receipt once.

accounts.name: destination_program
docs: on Devnet: [action accounts…, program id, escrow_auth, escrow]).

accounts.name: escrow_auth
docs: so only an action `publish_receipt` scheduled for this loan can write it.

accounts.name: escrow
docs: proves the call came through the real post-commit path.

instructions.name: refund_ticket
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Anyone refunds a liquidator's dead tickets to their own USDC account.

instructions.name: remove_loan_reader
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Either party removes a reader; access ends from now on.

accounts.name: lender
docs: The lender for `add_loan_reader`; the lender or borrower for `remove_loan_reader`.

accounts.name: borrower
docs: Required with the lender to add a reader.

instructions.name: repay
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Borrower pays part or all of the payoff, in any phase until settlement.

accounts.name: anchor
docs: Writable: on first acceptance it pays rent for the room deal record.

instructions.name: request_join
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Anyone asks to join a room from its public card.

instructions.name: retract_card
docs: Base layer. Publisher removes the card and reclaims rent.

instructions.name: revoke_member
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Owner removes a member and narrows both permissions.

instructions.name: revoke_session
docs: Ephemeral rollup. The authorising wallet revokes its session.

instructions.name: rotate_authorities
docs: Base layer. Governance (the Squads vault) rotates every authority.

instructions.name: schedule_watch
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Anyone schedules the Hydra watch for an active loan.

instructions.name: set_ai_worker
docs: Base layer. The AI admin from `Config` turns the copilot on or off.

instructions.name: set_desk_member
docs: Ephemeral rollup. An administrator adds, re-roles (roles != 0) or removes (roles == 0) a member.

instructions.name: settle_ticket
docs: Ephemeral rollup. A liquidator collects payout and excess, or a refund, once.

instructions.name: watch_loan
docs: Ephemeral rollup. Signer-free: risk or overdue quotes, and their execution.

errors.name: LoanNotExpired

errors.name: CompetingOfferAccepted

errors.name: AiDisabled

errors.name: NotAiWorker

errors.name: AlreadyAnswered

errors.name: RequestExpired

errors.name: TicketInPlay

errors.name: MintNotAllowed

errors.name: WrongAuthority

errors.name: InvalidAuthorities

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority

errors.name: TooEarly

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: LoanHealthy
errors.msg: Loan is healthy and cannot be liquidated

errors.name: InvalidPolicy
errors.msg: The desk policy is incomplete or inconsistent

errors.name: PolicyViolation
errors.msg: These terms are outside the desk's policy

errors.name: NotDeskAdmin
errors.msg: Only a desk administrator may perform this action

errors.name: NotDeskLender
errors.msg: Only a desk lender may originate under this desk

errors.name: LastDeskAdmin
errors.msg: A desk must keep at least one administrator

errors.name: AuditorMismatch
errors.msg: The auditor audience differs from the one shown for signing

fields.name: governance
docs: Squads vault PDA. Rotates every other key and holds the upgrade authority.

fields.name: ai_admin
docs: Registers and replaces the AI worker. Not a financial role.

fields.name: ai_worker
docs: Answers AI requests. Operational.

fields.name: liquidation_pool_admin
docs: Administers the liquidation-ticket pool's parameters.

fields.name: credential_issuer
docs: Issues credentials (later epics).

fields.name: keeper
docs: Triggers scheduled settlement checks. Operational and permissionless in effect.

fields.name: collateral_note
docs: Human-readable collateral note, e.g. "wSOL at up to 60% LTV".

fields.name: creator
docs: The lender who created the anchor and signs its first private setup.

fields.name: room
docs: Room the loan was agreed in. An opaque id; it names no wallet.

types.name: PolicyArgs
docs: Everything a loan under the desk must satisfy. Immutable once written.

fields.name: max_annual_ceiling_bps
docs: Required: the desk's annual pricing ceiling. Every loan's ceiling must be at or below it.

fields.name: repayment_modes
docs: Bits: MODE_FULL_TERM, MODE_PRO_RATA.

fields.name: status
docs: 0 until published; then the final loan status.

fields.name: request_index
docs: The borrowing request in the room this proposal answers. One proposal per request is accepted.
